children: China metals miner's interim revenue for six months to June 2026 rose yr/yr
Gross profit for the period more than doubled from prior year
Net income attributable to owners reached RMB442 mln, reversing prior year's loss
Daye Metals agrees to sell 100% of Daye Nonferrous Design and Research Institute to China No. 15 for RMB149.409123 mln, closing within 12 months
HIGHER METAL PRICES – H1 revenue rose 39.6%, mainly driven by higher prices for cathode copper, gold, silver and sulfuric acid
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT – Gross profit more than doubled as raw-material and product mix adjustments, cost cuts and technology upgrades lifted margins
